title: Guys, would you pay for a (custom) AI streamer to play your game?
author: nicotinum
selftext:
I've been playing around and serious question. Ofcourse the streamer could be 3d and so on.

Example:

https://www.youtube.com/live/20elQ8rfurM?is=ubjJpRbHFDGhytCY

replies.author: nicotinum
replies.body: it could drive sales the same way as regular streamers would in the ideal product

replies.author: Haunting-Frosting417
replies.body:
Dude… only big streamers are worth paying  
The point is to bring real audience

replies.author: nicotinum
replies.body: audience would come if you could tweak your own streamer to be really interesting.

comments.author: Calm_Look_3206
comments.body: No. Especially because you wouldn’t even have an audience, that’s the whole point.

replies.author: nicotinum
replies.body: what if there would be some critical mass of viewers and unlimited expansion possibility for no extra charge

replies.author: Calm_Look_3206
replies.body: Are you referring to bots? Lol

comments.author: Three_Tails_Studio
comments.body: This AI steamer has an audience of like 2? No thanks.

replies.author: nicotinum
replies.body: yeah this is just an early prototype. each ai streamer should still build itself up as an established streamer.

replies.author: Three_Tails_Studio
replies.body: Ok. So why are you asking us to pay for an AI streamer to stream to an audience of 0.

replies.author: nicotinum
replies.body: hmm. the example is just an example. not for this specific ai streamer. rather, if you could make one of your own. and build up and audience with a fraction of a cost. rather ai streamer service.

replies.author: Blake9712
replies.body: It can be 3 or even 4 but right now OP only has his phone and computer watching

replies.author: nicotinum
replies.body: the streamer is just to give an idea. im not expecting anyone to pay for this :D. rather, if you could build and run your own - paying for such service

comments.author: RuinousFate
comments.body: You'd need an audience and it actually needs to drive sales/engagements/clicks/interest. That's the whole point of paying for streamers

replies.author: nicotinum
replies.body: yes. all ai streamers would need to build audience by being very good still. ofcourse mine is just an example. but the idea itself.

comments.author: dtlater
comments.body:
I'm too old to understand how to even process why I'd want this

A person should want to play a game you release

comments.author: je386
comments.body:
What do you mean by "AI Streamer"?

A Streamer that streams about AI? Fine, could be interesting.

An AI that tries to be a streamer? I don't think that this is something that is appaling for people to watch.

replies.author: nicotinum
replies.body: giving them personality, context, long-term memory. i believe they could be quite fun in the end :)

replies.author: je386
replies.body:
Maybe I have to see this before I can decide if this maybe interesting for people to watch.

I don't have any budget for this and my games are a hobby for me, so maybe I am not the audience you are looking for

comments.author: atastycrow
comments.body: dude start it out and prove the concept. and then charge. you gotta invest first

comments.author: CckSkker
comments.body: That would feel like the death of the internet
